name: fx_fill_pal
disc: PAL SLES-52568 (deterministic, headless: a ps2r.ini with video.scale = 4 only, --deterministic --no-sdl-input --no-audio --skip-movies --trace-state; TE_GFX_GPU_TIMERS=breaks, TE_GFX_SUMMARY_EVERY=60; the hub card from hub_entry.padlog to 2700, warped by tools/warp_save.py --place 0xFFFF where a leg names a chunk)

tenth_dimension.what: the 10th dimension's sky of 51 layers (its red haze among them) waits for the opaque scene

academy_mist.what: the Academy courtyard's mist sheets (bucket 9) from the start of the hub

beach_waterfall.what: N. Sanity Beach's waterfall: two additive scrolling layers (bucket 11), no screen copy

jungle_sea.what: Jungle Bungle's sea at the cliff: 14 additive sheets in pairs (bucket 11), the largest blended fill found

iceberg_cave.what: Ice Climb's iceberg cave orbit: the ice pieces' refraction copies (the most copies of any leg)

why: The player's drops at 4x come where see-through layers pile up: the 10th dimension's haze (in its sky of 48-62 layers, drawn first and whole -- 17.5 Mpx a 4x frame -- because a sky could have at most 32 layers and still wait for the scene), the Academy's mist sheets, Jungle Bungle's sea sheets, the beach's waterfall; and every desktop draw ran the full PS2 fragment program, 2.4 times the fast one's cost per pixel. The judge counts what the GPU shades (GL_SAMPLES_PASSED per phase: the same for the same frames on any machine), never a time: the 10th dimension's sky waits for the scene and passes at most 9 Mpx a frame, every draw takes the fast program, the fog sheets' and the waterfall's blended fill stays within 10 % of its frozen value (the effects drawn, nothing drawn twice), the waterfall takes no screen copy and the iceberg cave's copies stay coalesced.
frozen: 2026-11-04: RED on f001055 (the base: the 10th dimension's sky 0 of its frames moved, 17.5 Mpx passed; no draw on the fast program), GREEN on fx-fog-water (the sky 1680 of 1680 frames moved with 51 layers, 6.51 Mpx; every draw fast; Academy 4.08, beach waterfall 3.01, jungle sea 15.88 Mpx blended in the worst window; 0 copies at the waterfall, 7.96 in the iceberg cave's worst window). Measured on this Mac (Apple M4); the counts are the GPU's, not its time.
